# Test fixtures

`icon.webp` is a project-generated 256×256 solid-color lossless WebP image;
`icon-lossy.webp` is a 256×256 lossy WebP image. They also exercise resizing
to the native icon cache's 128×128 limit. They are
used for reproducible download/retention and native decoder checks without
depending on an externally downloaded modpack icon. It is covered by the
project's GPL-3.0-or-later license.
